property_summary: For any non-empty _tos array and any callee that ALWAYS returns success, C.transfer always returns true (does not revert); the mutant that iterates i <= _tos.length will sometimes revert due to out-of-bounds access, breaking this property.
change_summary: Change the loop condition from i < _tos.length to i <= _tos.length, causing an out-of-bounds access and revert when equal, altering observable revert behavior for non-empty arrays.
